description: clip, the cut applied to a command's output before the model reads it. Input is {head, fill, count, tail}: the text is head, then fill repeated count times, then tail. Expected: {text, truncated}. Output over 30000 characters keeps its first 8000 and last 22000 around a cut marker. Characters are BMP only, since JavaScript counts UTF-16 units.

cases.name: a short line comes back whole
output exactly at the limit is not cut
one character over the limit is cut
a long output keeps its start and its end
a long log keeps the error at the end
